title: feat: add default-deny Organ control broker seam
body:
## Scope

Adds the first issue #111 implementation seam on exact parent \`dd1478e1f7c5528d81ed91a94e4db86c45971623\`.

- Adds independent \`ui/broker\` crate with a versioned, pointer-free protocol.
- Keeps durable Hepta K separate from boot-local HOS2 D.
- Authenticates the transport peer with kernel-reported same-UID credentials.
- Grants only observe, local-draft, and reconcile; effect submit/cancel are default-deny.
- Returns explicit unknown until an original owner receipt exists.
- Separates authority, body, resource, bridge, and owner generations.
- Adds bounded notification pull/reconcile and bounded replay/operation caches.
- Adds owner receipt validation as a future A07 boundary; no owner writer is exposed.
- Adds adversarial unit tests for unknown fields, peer UID, replay, generations, K/D separation, draft-only flow, owner receipt confirmation, and notification loss.
- Updates the UI workspace lock and documents the boundary in \`docs/ORGAN_BROKER.md\`.

## Safety boundary

This does not implement A05 CapSpace/process-start/exec_epoch, A06 enforcement, or A07 durable K↔D/Final-use/CNS/recovery. The broker has no signer, device handle, Agentd UDS, raw pointer, or effect owner. Its in-memory maps are bounded process caches and are intentionally lost on restart.

## Validation

A10 exact-head run 39277518380 for \`654e497b31d3297c071d363269faf192801bfc68\` passed rustfmt, workspace compile/tests, headless Wayland, all-target Clippy, and the committed lock gate. The current cache-boundary head is \`bb71c17dea658bb34a615050aca0db80f0c662a4\`; its A10 and ARM runs are queued behind the earlier ARM probe run.

The earlier \`9f664348...\` is the first parent of current main \`dd1478e1...\`, not the current base after the latest docs merge. This draft closes no production capability and should remain draft until A05/A07 owner integration is available.

title: docs(a05): freeze ReadUsage fail-closed contract
body:
## Summary

This read-only A05 slice audits the exact `dd1478e1f7c5528d81ed91a94e4db86c45971623` main head and records why ReadUsage must remain disabled.

- Adds an exact source inventory for Process/image session, ioctl, CPU owner, and os-control seams.
- Adds a host-only `test_readusage_contract.py` guard for QueryAbi-only support, Process/image fencing, the real N0 owner seam, and no kernel-side host-model grant shortcut.
- Wires that guard into G0 and A06; A06 still runs the ordinary exact-source x86_64 QEMU candidate and the four `EOPNOTSUPP` markers.
- Does not add CapSpace authority, a target registry, ReadUsage response handling, A07 K↔D durability, or any host-model evidence.

## Why this is a contract PR

The current head has no trusted kernel CapSpace grant admission or target-slot/generation resolver. The only real CPU observation path is the private, N0-only `Controller::read_native_cpu_usage_for_owner` seam, and production bootstrap does not call it. Enabling opcode 2 now would either infer authority from Process identity or use the host `os-control` model as kernel evidence.

The contract records the required next seams and the exact positive/negative QEMU receipt needed before advertising ReadUsage.

## Validation

- `python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests/kernel/control -p 'test_readusage_contract.py' -v` — 4 tests passed locally.
- The existing A06 workflow remains the exact kernel/QEMU regression and now runs this guard immediately before the ordinary QueryAbi candidate guest.
- Existing QueryAbi guest markers continue to require `HEPTA_DISABLED_READ_USAGE_OK` and the other three disabled operations.

Refs: #111.

title: docs(A03): record current HistoryAck boundary
body:
## Scope

This exact-main follow-up records the current status of desktop issue #28 at `main@9f66434889cc3bce31cfcccda950f0c48d6fa1b3`.

The host-model observer/forged-ack path is already fail-closed in the current main source:

- `retire_through` requires the non-Clone, namespace-instance/generation-bound `OriginalOwnerAuthority`;
- the private namespace receipt tag, exact namespace Arc, owner view, generation, and owner identity are checked;
- an observation-only `delivery_view()` cannot retire;
- `HistoryAck::from_owner_receipt` remains untrusted value-only evidence.

The existing adversarial regressions in `tests/control/control_conformance.rs` and `tests/control/delivery_adversarial.rs` cover observer-only retirement, foreign authorities, matching-owner forged receipts, namespace reuse, and pending prefixes.

## Change

Update `docs/STATUS.md` to remove the stale claim that current main still accepts syntactically valid forged receipts, and record the real remaining blocker:

- A05 has no real CapSpace/ioctl `RetireThrough` capability enforcement.
- A07 has no authenticated existing Hepta durable K↔D contiguous acknowledgement, fsync proof, or reboot/power-loss recovery.
- A host-model digest is not a durable owner proof.

This PR deliberately adds no fake durable owner, second ledger, signature claim, or kernel authority.

## Validation

- Exact source parent: `9f66434889cc3bce31cfcccda950f0c48d6fa1b3`
- Commit: `49afc66beb37be5c943815d3bfb4fcfff7734bf3`
- `git diff --check` passed locally.
- The required exact-head GitHub checks are intentionally left to this Draft PR; queued/cancelled checks must not be interpreted as qualification.

Issue #28 remains open until A05/A07 native evidence exists.
